_meta.generated_from: Adversarial OSINT credential audit, 7 August 2026. Derived from OCR of the canonical diploma PDFs plus the Registro Publico de Graduados Universitarios, CPACF, CPCECABA, CTPIPBA Moron, the State Bar of California, IAPP/credential.net and AWS/Credly.
_meta.sanitization_note: This is the PUBLIC-SAFE derivative of the private audit inventory. The following classes of data were removed and must never be reintroduced: national ID number, date and place of birth, university student IDs, transcript/eTranscript document IDs, digital-diploma access codes, association member IDs, the Lehigh GPA, the Argentine home address, the Argentine mobile number, and the personal Argentine email. Source-document filenames that embedded the national ID have had it redacted. See scripts/check-pii.mjs, which fails the build on any reappearance.
publication_rules: Publish the FACT of a credential plus a THIRD-PARTY VERIFICATION LINK. Never publish a diploma scan.
Never link to a prefilled CPACF detail URL: the query string carries a home address, a mobile number and a private email. Link to the search page and give the search terms.
Every public total must be computed from this file. No hardcoded counts anywhere in the site source.

counting_rules.dual_issue_note_en: The Universidad Europea del Atlántico (Spain) and Universidad Internacional Iberoamericana (Puerto Rico) titles are one dual-issued programme from two FUNIBER-network institutions, issued one month apart. They are counted ONCE in every programme total on this site. Both issued titles are listed individually so the record is complete.
counting_rules.dual_issue_note_es: Los títulos de la Universidad Europea del Atlántico (España) y de la Universidad Internacional Iberoamericana (Puerto Rico) corresponden a un único programa de doble emisión de dos instituciones de la red FUNIBER, emitidos con un mes de diferencia. Se cuentan UNA SOLA VEZ en todos los totales de programas de este sitio. Ambos títulos emitidos se listan por separado para que el registro quede completo.
counting_rules.tertiary_note_en: Two titles are educación superior no universitaria — non-university higher education. They are real, apostilled titles but they are not university degrees and do not appear in the national university registry. They are counted separately and never folded into the university total.
counting_rules.tertiary_note_es: Dos títulos son de educación superior no universitaria. Son títulos reales y apostillados, pero no son títulos universitarios y no figuran en el registro nacional universitario. Se cuentan por separado y nunca se suman al total universitario.
counting_rules.coursework_note_en: Two master's programmes are complete but hold no conferred degree. One has coursework only and no thesis. The other has its thesis defended and approved, with the título not yet issued. Neither is counted anywhere on this site, and neither appears in the national registry — correctly.
counting_rules.coursework_note_es: Dos maestrías están completas pero sin título otorgado. Una tiene solo la cursada, sin tesis. La otra tiene la tesis defendida y aprobada, con el título aún no emitido. Ninguna se cuenta en este sitio y ninguna figura en el registro nacional — correctamente.
